name: You've Got Tea
source:
Vincent Leung was your best friend. Years ago, he was also the reason for your broken heart.

Now he is back in your life as the owner of the new boba shop next to your tea store, and the neighbors are all glued to their seats to witness the new developments.

[From [url=https://chocoboknight.itch.io/youve-got-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
文森特·梁曾是你最好的朋友；而许多年前，他也是令你心碎神伤的罪魁祸首。

如今，他作为开在你茶叶铺隔壁的新珍珠奶茶店老板重新闯入了你的生活，街坊四邻更是全都搬好小板凳，目不转睛地坐等围观你们接下来的好戏。

[摘自[url=https://chocoboknight.itch.io/youve-got-tea]itch.io[/url]]
